architecture_summary: Two-stage local Memory pipeline: rollout extraction into SQLite candidates, restricted global consolidation into Markdown/Git artifacts, progressive lexical read, citation usage feedback.

components.name: Phase 1 extractor
components.responsibility: Per-rollout candidate extraction and structured output

components.name: MemoryStore
components.responsibility: Stage outputs, jobs, leases, watermarks and usage state

components.name: Phase 2 consolidation agent
components.responsibility: Incremental update of MEMORY.md, summary and skills in a constrained workspace

integration_constraints.constraint: Memory feature and state DB must be enabled/available
Phase 2 writes only inside the constrained Memory workspace

maintenance_evidence.finding: Pipeline and prompt templates are maintained in the open-source repository

issue_pr_findings.finding: Public issue reports possible concurrent Phase 2 selection drift

failure_modes.trigger: Phase 2 model misreads scope or conflict

failure_modes.impact: middle evidence is absent from candidate extraction

failure_modes.trigger: reset or forget affects files but source rollout remains eligible
failure_modes.impact: old content can be regenerated later

adoption_boundary: Open-source local host implementation; no claim about hosted deployment or production adoption.
